records.key: Tune UMAP's neighbourhood size and minimum distance to trade fine local structure against a smoother view of global relationships.
records.source: Tune UMAP's neighbourhood size and minimum distance to trade fine local structure against a smoother view of global relationships.
records.translation: Ajusta el tamaño del vecindario y la distancia mínima de UMAP para equilibrar la estructura local fina con una representación más suave de las relaciones globales.

records.key: Tune t-SNE's perplexity, learning rate, exaggeration and iteration budget when its neighbourhoods collapse or fail to separate.
records.source: Tune t-SNE's perplexity, learning rate, exaggeration and iteration budget when its neighbourhoods collapse or fail to separate.
records.translation: Ajusta la perplejidad, la tasa de aprendizaje, la exageración y el número de iteraciones de t-SNE cuando sus vecindarios colapsan o no se separan.
